articles.summary: Korn Ferry today announced that the firm will release financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027 (ended July 31, 2026) on Wednesday, September 9, 2026.
articles.title: Korn Ferry to Report Quarterly Earnings via Live Webcast on September 9, 2026

articles.summary: Korn Ferry today announced the completion of its acquisition of UK-headquartered AMS from OMERS Private Equity.
articles.title: Korn Ferry Completes Acquisition of AMS
